contract.index_semantics: k = completed non-skipped optimizer steps before the next update; initially zero
contract.advance_semantics: Prepare f(0) at construction; advance once after each applied optimizer step; do not advance on skipped attempts
contract.boundary_semantics: k>=T:0; k<W:(k+1)/W; otherwise:(T-k)/max(1,T-W). If 0<W<T the peak repeats; W>=T is retained without shortening

baseline.scope: Preview assumes every planned cohort exists and each optimizer attempt is applied; skipped attempts do not advance this LR index. No updates are executed.
